name: pagerduty-mcp
description: Every PagerDuty incident, on-call and service operation from the terminal, plus a local SQLite mirror that answers cross-entity questions — MTTA/MTTR, on-call coverage gaps, responder load — that neither the API nor the web UI can.

pagerduty_api_key.title: PAGERDUTY_API_KEY
pagerduty_api_key.description: Sets PAGERDUTY_API_KEY for the PagerDuty MCP server.

pagerduty_base_url.title: PagerDuty API base URL
pagerduty_base_url.description: Base URL for the PagerDuty API. Leave the prefilled default unless your account uses a different regional or self-hosted host.

pagerduty_mcp_read_only.title: Read-only mode
pagerduty_mcp_read_only.description: Optional. Set to 1 to make the MCP server refuse every write: only read tools are callable. Leave blank to allow writes (each MCP write still previews and sends only when called again with confirm set to true).

pagerduty_no_local_data.title: Run without a local copy
pagerduty_no_local_data.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API and sync refuses to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

pagerduty_user_agent.title: User-Agent header
pagerduty_user_agent.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on PagerDuty requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's built-in User-Agent.

pagerduty_mcp_http_token.title: MCP HTTP transport bearer token
pagerduty_mcp_http_token.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http (a remote/hosted deployment); at least 32 characters. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default local stdio transport that Claude Desktop uses.

printing_press_client_profile.title: Client profile
printing_press_client_profile.description: Binds this MCP server to one tenant-gated client profile. Leave blank to use the profile configured as default_client_profile.
